ModMetaData.name: RimRound: Nephila
ModMetaData.author: RandomDudeFromTheRim (port); HPregAnon, BiasNil (original)
ModMetaData.description:
The Nephila: gelatinous nanite-infested slime women caught in an endless cycle of swelling broods, rebuilt for RimWorld 1.6 as a companion to RimRound.
A ground-up port of HPregAnon's Nephila HPreg Mod (and BiasNil's later update): the race and its castes (maidens, handmaidens, matrons, grand matrons, queen's guard), the cherubim eggs, the Nephilitic fog and Eden biome, their faction, titles and gear.
What changed in the port: - No RimJobWorld. Reproductive organs come from Intimacy - Gender Works (with a few Nephila organs of its own), lactation from Lactation Expansion (or vanilla lactation without it). - Brood swelling feeds RimRound's weight system, and Nephila use RimRound's bodies as they grow. - Transformations, swelling and milking only ever touch adults (by life stage, so androids and other fast-maturing races count properly). - The code is rewritten: no per-tick mod-list scans, no errors from missing optional mods, transformed pawns keep their skills, traits, ideology and relations.
Original mod by HPregAnon; 1.3-1.5 update by BiasNil.
